independent_findings: Official OWR printed1361–1362 has the exact six relations and the two broad conjectures. Journal printed1198 and1202 has the same claims/presentation under parameter renaming c=alpha,d=beta. Both arXiv versions retain the conjectures.

The restriction on sharing the graded quotient ring or embedding in a geometric surface ring is separate. A surjective GKdim2 curve image refutes the literal map assertion and its prime kernel refutes the prime assertion; it does not refute the valid nongeometricity theorem.

Nevins–Sierra1206.0760v1(4June2012)p25 andv2(14April2014)pp28–29 repeat a no-map claim for the sameRS11 family. This is additional historical target context, not a predecessor counterexample. Currentv2 PDF has an internalDate15Nov2018 and must not be silently dated as a new arXiv version.

Rogalski–Zhang canonical map theorem requires strong noetherianness; RS journal finaldiscussion says its generic family is not strongly noetherian. Nevins–SierraTheorem1.2 has substantial coarse-point-moduli hypotheses; their conclusion specifically treatsRS11 as outside. Theorem4.10 universalfactor is not a THCR existence result.

Campbell2016Ch1,Ch6§6.4 andrelated deformations do not in the inspected passages identify this generic-family prime or quotient. Semigroup slides discuss the undeformedHeisenberg-monoid base and distinctnilpotent results, not a generic-family counterpart.
